name: Romantyczne Wileńskie Wersety
source:
Polish General, Lucjan Żeligowski, traveled in time and unexpectedly found himself in XXI-century Paris. Looking for a way to return to his home country, he stumbles upon a French girl named Elisabeth. Will she help him in this endeavor?

This visual novel was made on the Polish anime imageboard ziemniachan.org.
